The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

About Us: 
 

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities:
 

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Production Technician to join our microbial production team. In this role, you will play a key part in producing beneficial microorganisms used in biostimulant, biocontrol, and biofertilizer products that support healthy crop growth. Training will be provided, so prior microbiology experience is not required — though it's a plus. Curiosity and attention to detail matter most.
 

 
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• You independently carry out production tasks according to standard procedures: you prepare supplies, sterilize, inoculate, harvest and handle downstream processing. 

• You work under sterile conditions and strictly follow hygiene and sterility protocols, giving contamination no chance. 

• You safeguard product quality at every stage by performing in-process quality and sterility checks. 

• You help with downstream processing and carry out quantification checks as part of the final quality control. 

• You actively contribute to continuous improvement (TPM) and help find solutions when problems arise. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You have a technical or scientific background: a secondary school diploma, an associate degree (graduaat) or equivalent practical experience. 

• You enjoy steady, hands-on work and feel right at home in it. 

• You understand the basics of microbiology: you know what bacteria and fungi are and how contamination occurs, and you're interested in sterility and hygiene. 

• Repetitive tasks don't put you off: you stay focused and precise, even over long periods. 

• You can stand for extended periods and regularly lift and carry moderate loads without difficulty. 

• Have you worked with an ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook) before? That's a plus, but we'll train you either way. 

• You're responsible, reliable and a true team player, and safety and hygiene in the workplace come naturally to you. 

• You speak and write both Dutch and English fluently.

As a production worker, you will be responsible for sorting second-hand clothing. You will assess the clothing for stains, holes, and other imperfections, and sort them based on quality. This means you will categorize the items accordingly.

• You speak either very good Dutch or very good English or very good French

• The company is not easily accessible by public transport, so you have your own means of transportation.

• You do not have a dust allergy.

• You are willing to work full-time; part-time is not an option.

Responsibilities:   

 
•  
You support the development, optimization and management of technical products and solutions.
 
 
•  
You apply standards, guidelines and certification requirements, and support approval processes.
 
 
•  
You work closely with customers and translate their needs into technical solutions.
 
 
•  
You create and modify technical designs in CAD and manage the associated product data.
 
 
•  
You collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Production and Quality to address technical questions and challenges.
 

Required qualifications:   

 
•  
Master's degree in Electromechanics, supplemented with initial work experience.
 
 
•  
Practical knowledge of 3D CAD and MS Office.
 
 
•  
Strong motivation and willingness to deepen your knowledge of standards, regulations and certifications.
 
 
•  
Willingness to travel within Europe and the US.
 
 
•  
Analytical mindset and ability to critically assess technical data.
 
 
•  
Strong interpersonal skills and a good command of English.

• Involved in the (bio)-pharmaceutical drug development process of our clients. 

• Responsible for the development of complex LC-MS/MS methods for small molecules, proteins and/or oligonucleotides.  

• Operate & maintain LC-MS/MS and HRMS instrumentation, incl. routine performance checks, calibration and (basic) troubleshooting. You act as a subject matter expert on Mass Spectrometry. 

• Support the introduction, qualification and transfer of new MS technologies and analytical workflows. 

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• You deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards and interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects. 
  
 

• PhD (or Master equivalent by experience) in a scientific field with a strong (technical) focus on mass spectrometry. 

• Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS operation and troubleshooting on high resolution mass spectrometry platforms (ideally combined triple quad MS platforms) is essential. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work on complex analytical investigations, using a systematic root-cause approach to distinguish LC-, MS-, sample- and method-related issues.  

• Experience with a variety of chromatographic separations (e.g. RP-LC, HILIC) and/or nanoflow liquid chromatography is an additional asset. 

• Capable of working to the highest quality standards required to support development, qualification and validation of LC-MS based methods. 

• Proven ability to work in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Excellent organization and communication skills in English. Knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

We are currently looking for a CQV Engineer to join one of our clients, a major player in the pharmaceutical industry, for a mission based in Belgium.

Your Mission : 

As part of the Commissioning, Qualification and Validation team, you will contribute to ensuring that equipment, utilities and facilities meet regulatory (GMP) and quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle. Your main responsibilities will include:

• Drafting and reviewing CQV documentation (URS, protocols, reports: IQ, OQ, PQ)
• Coordinating and/or executing commissioning and qualification activities for equipment, utilities and facilities
• Ensuring compliance with GMP requirements and internal quality standards
• Managing deviations, investigations and change controls related to CQV activities
• Collaborating with Engineering, Quality, Production and Automation teams
• Supporting audits and regulatory inspections
• Tracking project timelines and reporting on CQV activities progress

• Proven experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry
• Solid knowledge of GMP requirements and the validation lifecycle (ASTM E2500 / FDA / EMA guidelines)
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch is a plus

• Strong communication and documentation skills 
• The opportunity to work on high-impact projects with a major player in the pharmaceutical industry
• A career partner that adapts to your goals, your pace and your professional project
• A team of passionate consultants dedicated to the health industry

• Create and update 2D technical drawings using AutoCAD
• Perform on-site surveys and translate existing installations into accurate as-built drawings
• Work across various building systems, including HVAC, electrical installations, utilities, sanitary systems and data/communication networks
• Ensure the quality and consistency of drawings, including scales, layers, symbols, references and revision status
• Consolidate existing drawings and integrate information from projects, suppliers and contractors
• Maintain a clear and structured approach to CAD documentation, file management and revisions
• Collaborate closely with Facility, Maintenance, Engineering and IT teams, as well as external engineering partners and contractors 
Your profile

• Technical background in Construction, Electromechanics, HVAC, Electricity, Technical Drafting, or equivalent through relevant experience
• Previous experience in technical drafting/CAD within a building, facility, engineering or industrial environment
• Strong command of 2D AutoCAD
• Good understanding of building systems and utilities, such as HVAC and electrical installations
• Comfortable carrying out field surveys and translating technical information into accurate drawings
• Familiar with drawing standards, revision management and document control
• Knowledge of Revit is considered an asset
• You are autonomous, structured and detail-oriented, with good communication skills
• Dutch & English required 
Practical information

• Start date: ASAP
